fact.title: EPF: 12% from you, 12% from the employer
fact.claim: You pay 12% of your wages into EPF and the employer pays 12%. The employer must deposit by the 15th of the next month.
fact.caveat: Reported. Source name to be confirmed.

script.cover_1: PF is cut from your salary. Does it reach your account?
script.payoff: Reports say the employer must deposit by the 15th of the next month.
script.caption: The cut shows on your payslip, but the deposit shows only in your passbook. Send this to the friend who never checks it.
script.situation: Can your employer deduct PF and deposit it whenever they like?
script.answer: Reports say the employer must deposit by the 15th of the next month, with 12% from each side.
script.reply_me: Could you share the date my PF for this month was deposited? It is due by the 15th.
